mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds rate above 2.5% in a given month reduces near-term discount rates, lowering the present value of expected equity cash flows and thereby depressing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 2.5% in the current month
regime_hint: Rising Fed Funds rate surprises in late-cycle expansion
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in the same month are not statistically lower than the prior month's returns (t-test p > 0.05), or the shock is not captured in market discount rates (IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the 12-month change in CPIAUCSL exceeds +2% in a month, it signals accelerating inflation expectations, prompting risk-averse investors to sell equities and pushing S&P 500 forward returns negative over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than the prior month's returns (p > 0.05), or the inflation surprise is not reflected in SPX discounting (IC > 0.04).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in monthly PAYEMS accompanied by a concurrent decline in UNRATE indicates strengthening labor market conditions and wage growth, which elevates equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by >10% in the current month AND UNRATE falls by >0.2 percentage points in the same month
regime_hint: Labor market tightening with wage growth
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not statistically higher than a baseline period with similar labor data but neutral wage trends (p > 0.05), or the interaction effect rank IC < 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly contraction in INDPRO below 100 (index) signals weakening business activity and rising supply-side pressures, which tend to depress future earnings expectations and produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than the prior month's returns (p > 0.05), or the SPX response is muted despite the supply contraction (IC < 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When monthly HOUST rises by more than 5% from the prior month, it reflects accelerated corporate demand for goods and services, which supports earnings expectations and yields positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically higher than in a month with similar HOUST but neutral momentum (p > 0.05), or the effect is not captured in SPX discounting (IC > 0.06).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in RSAFS for two consecutive months suggests persistent easing by the Federal Reserve, lowering real rates and increasing equity present value, which should produce positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS falls for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than a control period with no two-month RSAFS decline (p > 0.05), or IC < 0.08.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 5% for three consecutive months in a labor market recovery regime, it indicates improving labor market conditions and rising wage bargaining power, which tends to support equity valuations and drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically higher than in a neutral UNRATE regime (p > 0.05), or the effect is not reflected in SPX discounting (IC > 0.07).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in GDPC1 accompanied by a simultaneous rise in CPIAUCSL (>2%) signals demand-driven inflation without supply-side easing, which tends to compress equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 falls by >5% in the current month AND CPIAUCSL rises by >2% in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than in a month with neutral GDP and stable inflation (p > 0.05), or the interaction effect rank IC < 0.1.
